title: CoordinateTimeGravityTrain: companion code and student notebook for the gravitational train in the interior Schwarzschild metric
description:
Companion code for the paper The Gravitational Train in the Interior Schwarzschild Metric: NLO and NNLO Perturbative Expansions (I. Rosignoli, submitted to the European Journal of Physics). A particle released from rest at the surface of a homogeneous star slides without friction through a tunnel to another surface point; in general relativity the tunnel that minimises the coordinate travel time is a geodesic of an optical metric and follows a radial Snell law.

  • gravity_train.py: documented core physics (metric functions, optical index, Snell integrals, travel times, perturbative formulas, high-compactness analysis).
  • checks/ and run_all_checks.py: symbolic (SymPy and Wolfram Language) and numerical checks of the results of the paper, from the interior Schwarzschild metric (Appendix A) to the thresholds of Sec. VII, one PASS/FAIL line per check.
  • figures/: scripts for Figs. 1 and 2.
  • notebooks/gravity_train_exercise.ipynb: computational exercise for students, runnable in a web browser (Google Colab) without installation.

Python 3 with NumPy, SciPy, SymPy, mpmath and Matplotlib; python3 run_all_checks.py runs all checks in about 20 s. The scripts released with the original submission (June 2026) are preserved under the git tag v1.0-as-submitted.
